edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems); the variant readings it marks are left out and punctuation is added at the source’s own phrase breaks.
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本），删去其所注异文，标点依原文断句补加。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died around 858.
basis.zh: 唐诗，作者约卒于 858 年。

note.en: Li Shangyin, serving far away in the southwest, answers a letter asking when he will come back; scholars still differ on whether it was written to his wife or a friend. ‘Night rain in the Ba hills’ appears twice: first as the lonely present, then as a memory the two of them will share one day by candlelight. It is a poem written from the future looking back, which makes it a natural fit for a library meant to be read later.
note.zh: 李商隐远在西南任职，回答一封问他归期的信；这首诗是寄给妻子还是朋友，学者至今看法不一。“巴山夜雨”出现了两次：第一次是孤寂的此刻，第二次是将来某天两人在烛下共同的回忆。这是一首从未来回望此刻的诗，因此很适合一座为日后的读者而建的图书馆。

excerpt.orig: 何當共剪西窗燭，卻話巴山夜雨時。
excerpt.en: When shall we trim the wick together by the west window / and talk about this night of rain in the Ba hills?
excerpt.zh: 何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时。

gloss.en: 君: someone in the north. Traditionally the poet’s wife, though she may already have died; some think a friend in Chang’an.
gloss.zh: 君：北方的亲人或友人。旧说指妻子王氏，但有学者考证作诗时王氏已去世，故一说是寄给长安友人的。

gloss.en: The hills of Ba, in eastern Sichuan, where Li Shangyin was serving on a governor’s staff.
gloss.zh: 巴山：泛指川东一带的山，李商隐当时在东川节度使幕府任职。

gloss.en: To trim the candle wick together: to sit up late talking.
gloss.zh: 剪烛：剪去燃过的烛芯，使烛光明亮，指深夜长谈。

gloss.en: 卻: then, looking back. To talk over this night from the far side of it.
gloss.zh: 却：再，回头。却话，回过头来谈论。
